title: Tech Note: Modifying Data Grid Columns

historical_commentary.text: Another entry in the 4DAF Data Grid documentation series from 2008, covering column-level customization API calls; like the related drag-and-drop and CSS notes from the same era, its specific object model has been fully retired along with the rest of the 4D Ajax Framework.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has been discontinued; column-level grid customization in modern 4D web apps is handled by Qodly Studio components or custom JS/HTML5 tables rather than the 4DAF Data Grid API
